Visual effects and computer animation

We produce animation, illustration and visual effects for commercials, video, advertising and game graphics. The work is done with your creative leads in the loop rather than handed back at the end, so you and your client can see where a piece is going long before it is finished.

Our creative teams are staffed with people who have spent years doing this work. That is what keeps a project on track from the first storyboard to final delivery.

Why produce in India

India has become a serious animation outsourcing destination, and for straightforward reasons: a large English-speaking workforce, established studios, a substantial domestic entertainment industry, a deep literary tradition to draw content partnerships from, and current hardware and software throughout.

Cost is the other half of it. Animation production in India remains cheaper than Canada, Korea, Taiwan or the Philippines for comparable work.

australia-mortgage-leads.heading: Australia Mortgage Leads
australia-mortgage-leads.title: Australia Mortgage Leads — Home Loan Lead Generation for Brokers and Lenders
australia-mortgage-leads.description: Targeted telemarketing mortgage and home loan leads for Australian brokers, lenders and mortgage managers. Exclusive, real-time and qualified by phone before delivery.
australia-mortgage-leads.keywords: australia mortgage leads, home loan leads australia, mortgage broker leads, telemarketing mortgage leads, exclusive mortgage leads australia
australia-mortgage-leads.excerpt: Targeted telemarketing mortgage and home loan leads for Australian brokers, lenders and mortgage managers — exclusive to you and qualified by phone before delivery.
australia-mortgage-leads.body:
We generate targeted telemarketing mortgage leads and home loan leads for Australian mortgage brokers, lenders and mortgage managers. Each lead is qualified by an agent against your criteria, so your sales team spends its day on conversations worth having.

How we measure a lead programme

We measure lead generation on cost per acquisition, not cost per record. Generic mortgage leads typically run at 10% to 50% of the cost of a custom, branded programme — but in consumer markets the cheapest source is rarely the one that produces the most funded loans.

The difference shows up on the call. When you ring a real-time, exclusive lead generated in your own name, the prospect already knows who you are and why you are calling. Nobody has to explain where the enquiry came from, and nobody has been called by three of your competitors first.

Whether you follow up by auto-responder email, by phone from a call centre, or both, custom-generated leads convert at a higher rate. We can pair the campaign with other online techniques that feed the same pipeline.

If your current source has stopped working

Co-registration, opt-out lists and generic shared leads all have the same failure mode: you cannot tell what you are buying until you have paid for it. If that is where your results have gone, a branded custom programme is usually the fix.

Talk to us about volume, states and loan types and we will tell you what is realistic.

back-office-india.excerpt: Back office outsourcing for financial services, healthcare, insurance, mortgage and debt management — so your own people spend their time on the work that grows the business.
back-office-india.body:
Ring India is a back office outsourcing specialist working with financial services, healthcare, insurance, home loan and mortgage, and debt management clients, alongside a range of web-enabled services.

The pressure is the same everywhere: run the operation for less, raise productivity, and hold quality steady while doing both. Senior managers end up owning cost structures and throughput targets that are difficult to hit while the same team is also processing the day-to-day paperwork.

That is the case for moving back office work out. Not to save a line on a budget, but to give your own people their time back for the work that actually grows the business.

What we process

  • Data processing and digitisation — converting text and images to electronic form, and creating structured text from other formats.
  • Finance and accounting — bookkeeping, billing and receivables, payables, claims processing.
  • Healthcare — transcription, claims and collections, verification, scheduling.
  • Insurance — application processing, verification, claims processing.
  • Legal — transcription, deposition typing, data processing, research, collections.
  • Pre-publishing — layout, typing, proofing, printer-ready copy.
  • Credit card processing
  • Research and data gathering
  • Web-enabled services — site promotion, web marketing, email marketing and SEO.

Processes our team handles

Our back office team has run the following across client accounts:

HR servicesBenefits administration, employee HR help desk, payroll processing, claims processing, recruitment and résumé data management
Sales and marketingRebate processing, loyalty programmes, lead generation, order processing, returns tracking
Finance and accountsAccounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliation, general ledger, fixed assets
AdministrativeRecord and data maintenance, document verification, product registration, warranty processing
Transcription servicesMedical, legal and general transcription
Data captureForms processing, travel and entertainment expense capture

Describe the process you are thinking of moving — volumes, turnaround and how it is handled today — on the contact page, and we will come back with a proposal.

bankruptcy-leads.body:
Bankruptcy leads

We generate bankruptcy leads across the US. These are people who have started weighing up whether to file and are looking for help before they do — the point at which debt help, a settlement plan or a bankruptcy evaluation with an attorney is still something they will listen to.

We also supply discharged bankruptcy leads: people whose bankruptcy has already been discharged and who are now trying to rebuild their credit. If you write secured cards, credit-builder loans or subprime auto finance, that is a different conversation and a different list, and we keep the two separate.

Every record is worked by an agent before it reaches you, against the filing status, debt level and state criteria you set.

Ask us for the sample format and tell us the volume and states you want covered — we will come back with a proposal.

business-process-outsourcing.heading: Business Process Outsourcing
business-process-outsourcing.title: BPO Services India — Offshore Business Process Outsourcing and Consulting
business-process-outsourcing.description: Offshore BPO and consulting from India for financial services, healthcare, insurance, mortgage and debt management — IT-enabled services, back office processing and full process transition.
business-process-outsourcing.keywords: bpo services india, business process outsourcing india, offshore outsourcing, it enabled services, back office processing india, bpo provider
business-process-outsourcing.excerpt: Offshore business process outsourcing and consulting from India — IT-enabled services, back office processing and the transition work that gets a process safely out of your building.
business-process-outsourcing.body:
We provide offshore outsourcing and consulting from India: IT-enabled services, back office outsourcing and full business process outsourcing, with a focus on financial services, healthcare, insurance, home loan and mortgage, and debt management.

The reason to outsource a process is rarely the hourly rate on its own. It is that every hour your own team spends on repeatable processing is an hour it is not spending on the work only it can do. Moving the repeatable part out is what frees the rest.

Why processes move to India

  • Cost structure — a materially lower cost base for the same work, sustained rather than promotional.
  • Economies of scale — shared infrastructure and staffing across accounts, so you are not paying to build a function from scratch.
  • Risk spread — a second location running the same process, away from your own site risk.
  • Depth of skill — teams who do one process all day, every day, rather than fitting it around another job.
  • Utilisation — overlapping shifts that cover your working day and the overnight window either side of it.

Processes our team handles

HR servicesBenefits administration, employee HR help desk, payroll processing, claims processing, recruitment and résumé data management
Sales and marketingRebate processing, loyalty programmes, lead generation, order processing, returns tracking
Finance and accountsAccounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliation, general ledger, fixed assets
AdministrativeRecord and data maintenance, document verification, product registration, warranty processing
Transcription servicesMedical, legal and general transcription
Data captureForms processing, travel and entertainment expense capture

Tell us which process you are considering and how it runs today on the contact page, and we will scope the transition.

call-center-india.excerpt: Contact centres across the Asia Pacific region, headquartered in New Delhi, running inbound and outbound programmes for clients in the US, UK and Australia.
call-center-india.body:
Ring India is a network of independent third-party contact centres across the Asia Pacific region, with delivery partners in India, the Philippines, Mauritius, Singapore, Hong Kong and Malaysia, headquartered in New Delhi.

We run voice and web-based campaigns for clients throughout the US, Europe and Australia, built around what each client counts as a result.

How we charge

Inbound and outbound telemarketing runs on a pay-per-performance basis: you are billed for outcomes, not for seat hours. Around that sit help desk, sales lead generation, billing, technical support, product enquiry handling, order processing, up-selling and cross-selling, market surveys and research, database management, data entry, email campaigns and fax broadcasting.

What the centres handle

Our teams currently take order lines, provide infomercial and direct response support, run help desks, absorb overflow call volume, handle dealer locate enquiries and cover general customer service. Each of those gives you telephone or web-based support at a fraction of what it costs to staff and run the same function in-house.

We stay the single point of contact for the whole engagement — systems design and integration, software development, and production support after go-live — so there is one number to call when something needs changing.

If you are serious about keeping and growing your customer relationships, tell us what you need and we will show you what the programme would look like.

canada-mortgage-leads.title: Canada Mortgage Leads — Home Loan and Refinance Lead Generation for Canadian Lenders
canada-mortgage-leads.description: Exclusive Canada mortgage leads for Canadian brokers and lenders: home loan, commercial mortgage and refinance enquiries, quality-checked against call recordings before delivery.
canada-mortgage-leads.keywords: canada mortgage leads, canadian mortgage lead generation, home loan leads canada, refinance leads canada, commercial mortgage leads canada
canada-mortgage-leads.excerpt: Exclusive home loan, commercial mortgage and refinance leads for Canadian brokers and lenders — every record checked against the call recording before it is delivered.
canada-mortgage-leads.body:
We generate Canada mortgage leads for Canadian brokers, lenders and mortgage managers: home loan leads, commercial mortgage leads and refinance enquiries, supplied exclusively and never resold.

Judge a lead source on what it costs to close a loan, not what it costs to buy a record. A cheap shared lead that four brokers are calling is more expensive than it looks by the time it reaches your funding numbers.

We supply volume against your own criteria, and we check it. Our quality team listens back to the recordings of the calls our agents make, which is the only reliable way to know a lead was qualified rather than simply logged.

Canada mortgage refinance leads

Refinance decisions come down to two numbers: the interest rate and the monthly payment. Our agents only move a homeowner forward as a refinance lead when the case genuinely improves on what they are paying now — if the numbers do not work, the record does not reach you.

That is also why clients come back for more: leads that were qualified honestly convert, and leads that were not waste your team's week.

If you are looking for fresh Canada home loan or refinance leads, tell us your provinces, loan types and volume.

data-entry.excerpt: Data entry, checking and digitisation at volume — paper or digital in, indexed and searchable out, in whatever format your systems actually read.

Data entry and back office work, priced by the job

We handle data entry, data checking, research and general back office work, priced according to what the job actually involves rather than a flat rate that suits us and not you.

We digitise your data and return it in whatever format is useful at the other end. Indexed and searchable is the default, not an extra. Need it as a mail merge file, a database after OCR, or reformatted to load into your reporting system? That is the ordinary case, not the exception.

Paper or digital, we take the source material and make it usable.

Beyond keying

Our data entry team can input any format you have. Where it helps, we also design the data structures and build the databases — Access, SQL Server or Oracle — including indexes, triggers and stored procedures. If you need something we have not listed, ask; the answer is usually yes.

We are set up for volume and for accuracy at speed. Send us a sample and a turnaround target and we will quote against it.

database-management.title: Database Management Services — Data Mining, Enhancement and Cleansing
database-management.description: Database design, upgrades, backup and capacity management, plus data mining, enhancement, cleansing and disciplined data entry for B2B and B2C marketing databases.
database-management.keywords: database management services, data mining, data cleansing, data enhancement, database design, marketing database management
database-management.excerpt: Database design, upgrades and capacity management, plus the data work around it — mining, enhancement, cleansing and accurate entry.
database-management.body:
Our database services cover secure, well-tuned management of the data your marketing runs on: design and enhancement, installation and upgrades, backup and restoration, and performance and capacity management.

For telemarketing work, B2B or B2C, that means one supplier for the campaign and the data behind it.

Database management

We build the business models marketing teams actually use — retention, cross-sell and response models — and produce analysis that shows customer behaviour across every channel: web, direct marketing, sales, contact centre and operations.

Data mining

We pull input from a range of sources and run it through statistical analysis, building optimisation models and algorithms that surface the characteristics your best customers share.

Data enhancement

We append demographic and lifestyle data from outside sources to build profiles of buying behaviour, whether the audience is consumers or professionals.

Data cleansing

Our programs find duplicates and problem records, and we run tests against the file specifically looking for the errors that break a campaign once it is live.

Data entry

Accurate input is not a nice-to-have; it is the whole job. Custom entry screens with the right validation in place mean fewer corrections downstream, and quality checks run both online and offline against pre-agreed comparisons.

We would rather work out the right approach with you than sell you a package. Get in touch and tell us what your data looks like today.

lead-generation.body:
We generate qualified prospects so your sales team stops burning its day on cold calls. Our agents make the first approach and do the qualifying; by the time a name reaches your people, the prospect has agreed to the conversation and knows roughly what it is about.

That is the whole proposition, and it is backed by decades of combined experience in telemarketing and marketing services. So — where do you want to start?

Telemarketing lead generation

Pay by the hour, by the campaign, on commission, or any combination we agree. No hiring, training, replacing, payroll taxes, workers' compensation or supervision on your side. You get experienced callers without the cost and complication of running a telemarketing floor, and without asking your salespeople to do a job they were not hired for.

Mortgage lead generation

A proven process for generating mortgage leads by phone. Leads are exclusive, delivered the same day they are generated, and qualified on rate and LTV. Clients typically convert 30% to 50% of them into completed 1003s.

Mobile phone lead generation

We have sold mobile phones across the US, UK and Australia, working with major carriers including AT&T, Sprint, T-Mobile and Telstra. Send us the month's offers and we will move the inventory. More detail on the mobile lead generation page.

Real estate lead generation

No door-knocking required. We target the homeowners or renters that match your brief specifically, drawing on multiple lead sources, and hand you only the ones that fit.

Telemarketing for CPA firms

We generate leads from individuals and businesses actively looking for accounting services — a direct route to new accounts for a CPA firm rather than a list of names who have never heard of you.

Bankruptcy leads

People weighing up whether to file, who are looking for help before they do. You can offer them debt help or a bankruptcy evaluation with an attorney while they are still deciding. We also supply discharged-bankruptcy records for lenders working with people rebuilding their credit.

Home foreclosure leads

Homeowners at real risk of losing their property, actively looking for someone who can help them out of it.

We are an international outbound contact centre specialising in mobile phone lead generation. We have sold handsets across the US, UK and Australia, working with major carriers including AT&T, Sprint, T-Mobile and Telstra.

The model is simple: send us the month's offers and we generate the connections. Our agents put new users on the latest handsets with tariff plans that stand up against what the prospect is paying now.

If you are sitting on stock

Distributors and stockists carrying handset inventory they need to move are exactly who this campaign is built for. We supply opt-in new users, generated to order, rather than a list you have to work through yourself.

How we do it

Our tele-sales executives specialise in this market and nothing else. They know which suppliers price competitively and how the current contract offers compare, which is what lets them hold a conversation rather than read a script. If you think your stock and pricing can beat what is on the market, that is the conversation we want to have.

We call and qualify on your behalf, using the outbound survey technique we apply across every campaign we run. Tell us your offers and target volume.

mortgage-leads.description: Targeted telemarketing mortgage leads for US brokers and lenders: purchase, refinance, home improvement, reverse and commercial mortgage, plus UK and Australia coverage.
mortgage-leads.keywords: us mortgage leads, telemarketing mortgage leads, refinance leads, home improvement leads, reverse mortgage leads, commercial mortgage leads, exclusive mortgage leads
mortgage-leads.excerpt: Targeted telemarketing mortgage leads for US brokers and lenders — exclusive, generated the day you get them, and qualified on rate and LTV.
mortgage-leads.body:
We generate high-quality targeted telemarketing mortgage leads for US brokers and lenders: home loan, refinance, home improvement, reverse mortgage and commercial mortgage. We run the same programme for the UK and Australian markets.

The upfront cost of a lead generation programme is higher than buying records off a list. It is also more than offset by what those records convert at. Prices across the industry vary enormously, and branded mortgage lead generation is very much a case of getting what you pay for.

Refinance leads

Exclusive, shared or non-exclusive refinance leads, general or filtered to your criteria. We would rather win the account on the quality of the leads and keep it on the service around them.

Insurance leads

If you also write cover, we supply life, health, long-term care, annuity, disability, auto, homeowners and financial planning leads. Detail on the insurance leads page.

How we measure a programme

We measure on cost per acquisition. Generic leads typically cost 10% to 50% of a custom branded programme — but in consumer markets the cheapest source rarely produces the most funded loans.

The reason is resale. A generic lead is often sold to two to five lenders, so you are racing competitors to a prospect who has already fielded four calls. A custom-generated lead belongs to you outright, and can be resold as semi-exclusive once it matures at 30 to 60 days, which brings your effective cost per customer down again.

Whether you follow up by auto-responder email, from a call centre, or both, custom leads run hotter and sell through at a higher rate. We can pair the campaign with other online techniques that feed the same pipeline.

If your current source has stopped working

Co-registration, opt-out lists and generic shared leads share one problem: you cannot judge what you bought until after you have paid for it. If that is where your numbers have gone, talk to us about a branded programme instead.

offshore-collection-services.heading: Offshore Collection Services
offshore-collection-services.title: Offshore Collection Services — Inbound and Outbound Receivables Recovery
offshore-collection-services.description: Offshore collections for utilities, mortgage, telecom, insurance, healthcare, auto and education loans, child support and cards — collectors at a fraction of in-house cost.
offshore-collection-services.keywords: offshore collection services, debt collection outsourcing, receivables recovery, outbound collections, accounts receivable outsourcing india, skip tracing
offshore-collection-services.excerpt: Inbound and outbound collections aimed at overdue accounts and cash flow — collectors at rates below what training and housing the same staff would cost you.
offshore-collection-services.body:
Customers who do not pay cost you money, whatever the sector — utilities, home mortgage, telecom, insurance, healthcare, auto loans, education loans, child support, banking and cards. Slow receivables are reduced profit, and you already know the pattern: debtors respond far better when they are contacted early in the cycle and contacted consistently.

If you had the floor space to hire more collectors, the time to train them and the supervisors to keep them motivated, you would have done it already. That is the honest reason most collection functions stay understaffed.

What makes this hard

Tracing a debtor who has moved or given you incomplete information is a job in itself. Finding an outsourcing partner who matches your service standard at a defensible fee is harder still — pick a large offshore firm on price and performance, and service is usually what gets sacrificed.

What we offer instead

We combine the control of using your own staff with the economics of outsourcing: lower labour cost, lower operating cost, and no recruitment or facilities burden. Our collectors cost less than training, paying and housing additional in-house staff, and considerably less than the share you give up placing a portfolio with an agency.

This will not suit everyone, and we will say so if it does not suit you.

Pricing

Plans vary with the type and size of the debt, the original credit quality, the number of debtors, the age of the accounts and how good your debtor information is. Contact us to arrange a confidential consultation at no fee.

our-people.heading: Our People
our-people.title: Our People — Agent Training, Coaching and Quality Standards
our-people.description: Certified contact centre agents trained by international telemarketing specialists, with mandatory induction workshops and continuous coaching against quality benchmarks.
our-people.keywords: call centre agent training, telemarketing training india, crm training, contact centre quality, agent coaching, telesales experts
our-people.excerpt: Agents are the product. Ours are certified, trained by international telemarketing specialists, and coached continuously against quality benchmarks.
our-people.body:
Agents are the main ingredient in any contact centre. A service is only ever as good as the people delivering it — which is why we treat training as the product, not as overhead.

Our asset is the certified agents working across the Ring India network, and the customer relationship management practice they are trained in.

How we train

Agents work through interactive training programmes developed by international telemarketing specialists, and every one of them gets hands-on practice before taking a live call. On the telemarketing side, the team is made up of telesales specialists rather than generalists moved across from another desk.

Training, learning and benchmarking are what hold call quality steady over the life of a campaign. Coaching is continuous, not a one-off induction, and it is aimed as much at each agent's own progression as at this quarter's numbers.

Mandatory for every new associate

  • Telemarketing skills
  • Listening skills
  • Telephone etiquette
  • Customer relationship management
  • Communication and team effectiveness
  • Team building and leadership
  • Time management

After induction

Training starts with fundamentals and moves on to e-commerce customer service and e-business. Product knowledge and market research feed straight back into the floor, and we lean heavily on role-play — it is the only reliable way to find out whether someone can handle a call before a customer does.

We encourage clients to take part. Nobody can brief our agents on your customers and your real-world objections better than your own team can.

Get in touch to talk about how a campaign team would be trained for your account.

outbound-telemarketing-services.excerpt: Customised outbound programmes — product enquiry, order processing, up-selling, fulfilment, lead generation and research — run on predictive dialling and a managed script.
outbound-telemarketing-services.body:
A customised telemarketing programme goes further than answering questions. Alongside supporting your customers, our team tracks and reports recurring operational problems and keeps user guides and scripts current, so the campaign improves as it runs.

Whether the campaign is broad or tightly targeted, the economics come down to one thing: how many useful conversations a representative can have in a shift. Our database and call management network builds the script, stores prospect information, places the calls and records the outcome of each one. Predictive dialling works the list and passes through only the calls answered by a live voice; everything else is rescheduled for a call-back.

Product enquiry

Good service is what sells a product twice. Our representatives are trained and experienced enough to answer properly, so your company stays responsive to customers rather than merely reachable.

Order processing

We process orders received by post, fax, phone and internet, covering cashiering, inbound and outbound telemarketing, up-selling and cross-selling, data entry and label processing, and lettershop services for list management and mailing.

Up-selling and cross-selling

We apply up-sell and cross-sell technique on inbound and outbound order programmes, which is usually the cheapest revenue available to a client already paying for the call.

Enquiry management and fulfilment

Our fulfilment division handles outsourced fulfilment end to end. Order entry and handling are set up so products arrive on time — the part of the transaction customers remember.

Lead generation

Lead generation programmes identify the households and businesses most likely to buy. Our specialists know how to get past a screen, reach a decision maker, build interest, probe and ask the qualifying questions that separate a prospect from a name.

Surveys and polling

Our outbound research work falls into two groups: market research, and surveys and polling.

Tell us what you need called and we will scope the campaign.

outsource-to-india.heading: Outsourcing to India
outsource-to-india.title: Outsource to India — Cost, Quality and Capability for Contact Centre and BPO Work
outsource-to-india.description: Why contact centre and BPO work is outsourced to India: skilled people, global delivery experience, mature technology and a cost base that holds up over the long term.
outsource-to-india.keywords: outsource to india, india outsourcing benefits, offshore outsourcing india, b2b b2c telemarketing, cost effective outsourcing, indian it talent
outsource-to-india.excerpt: Why work moves to India — skilled people, real experience delivering to global clients, mature technology, and a cost base that holds up over years rather than quarters.
outsource-to-india.body:
Outsourcing to India buys you technological flexibility, quality, control over cost, faster time to market and — done properly — a competitive advantage. What it should not buy you is a compromise on any of them.

For contact centre and telemarketing work, B2B or B2C, we are a single supplier for the whole requirement.

Why the work comes here

  • Depth of talent. A large, English-speaking, technically trained workforce, available at the scale a campaign needs.
  • Global delivery experience. Indian firms export software and services worldwide, so working to another country's methodology and compliance standards is routine rather than novel.
  • The confidence of large corporations. India has been the default destination for outsourced software and process work for decades, which means a deep bench of people who have done this before.
  • Mature technology. Current infrastructure and platforms, so total solutions can be delivered here rather than half-built and shipped.
  • Work that has moved up the value chain. Offshore assignments are no longer data entry alone; complex, multi-year turnkey projects are now standard.

How we hold quality

We keep the balance between technology, systems and the people running them, because nothing matters more to a client than work that comes back right the first time. Those practices are documented company-wide, and you can read about each of them:

  • Quality
  • Infrastructure
  • Our people
  • Advisory panel

Get in touch and tell us what you are considering moving.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.title: Privacy Policy — What Ring India Collects and How to Opt Out
privacy.description: What ringindia.net collects, what it is used for, when it is shared with other organisations, and how to have your details removed from any list we share.
privacy.keywords: ring india privacy policy, data protection, opt out, do not share list, email privacy
privacy.excerpt: What we collect, what we use it for, when it is shared, and how to have your details removed. One email address handles every request on this page.
privacy.body:
You can reach us about anything on this page at privacy@ringindia.net. Every opt-out described below is handled at that address.

What we collect

When you visit this site, our web server records the visitor's domain name. It does not record your email address.

Beyond that, we hold what you give us: the email address of anyone who writes to us, and any information you volunteer — survey responses, registrations and the detail you include in an enquiry.

What we use it for

We use it to improve what is on this site, to tailor the content, to tell you about updates, and to contact you about our services.

If you would rather not hear from us, email privacy@ringindia.net and say so. We will stop.

When we share it

From time to time we make email addresses from this site, and our customer email list, available to other reputable organisations whose products or services we think may interest you.

If you would rather we did not, email us and ask to be added to our do-not-share list. Please include your exact name and address so we can be certain the right record is removed from the lists we share.

Post and telephone

If you give us a postal address, you may receive occasional mailings from us about new services or events, and you may receive mailings from other reputable companies. If you give us a telephone number, we may call you about an enquiry you have made, and about new services or events; other reputable companies may also call.

Both are covered by the same do-not-share list. Email us with your exact name, address and phone number and we will remove you from the lists we share.

Questions

Anything else about your data, ask us at privacy@ringindia.net, or through the contact page.

quality.heading: Quality
quality.title: Quality Assurance — Call Monitoring, Verification and Customer Feedback
quality.description: How Ring India holds call quality: monitoring of every inbound and outbound campaign, verification of each sale before delivery, recorded calls, and structured feedback loops.
quality.keywords: call centre quality assurance, call monitoring, sale verification, customer feedback, quality standards call centre india, escalation process
quality.excerpt: Quality assurance that shows its work: calls monitored and recorded, every sale verified before it reaches the client, and feedback that reaches the agent who needs it.
quality.body:
Quality is an attitude before it is a process, and it is the reason clients stay with our network of contact centres. It starts with how people approach their own work, and it shows up in the call.

Our Quality Assurance team exists to extend that practice and to teach it — sharing what it learns across the floor, with one aim: to do better on every call we make. We work to international standards for contact centre services, and we can evidence it rather than assert it.

What the QA team does

  • Monitors inbound and outbound calls for compliance with our quality standard, with structured monitoring sessions run for customer care associates to measure call quality rather than guess at it.
  • Collects customer feedback quarterly through the relationship management team, and annually through an external customer satisfaction survey.
  • Records calls digitally, both for reference and as training material.
  • Verifies every sale before it is forwarded to the client — nothing reaches you unchecked.
  • Works with the operations team so quality feedback reaches the agent who needs it, while the call is still fresh.
  • Works with the training team on refresher modules where monitoring shows they are needed.
  • Runs an Award of Excellence for consistent performers.
  • Keeps the agent-to-supervisor ratio as tight as 1:7, depending on the service.
  • Maintains structured escalation paths for the technical and difficult requests that a script cannot cover.

Behind the standard

Our graduate and postgraduate workforce is trained continuously by in-house professionals across call answering, interactive response, web-based call handling and technical support.

Ask us how we would measure quality on your campaign specifically — it is a fair question and we would rather answer it before you sign anything.

terms.body:
These terms apply to your use of ringindia.net and to the services described on it. Anything agreed in a signed contract or written proposal takes precedence over this page.

Using this site

The content here — text, images and page design — belongs to Ring India. You are welcome to read it, quote from it with attribution and link to it. You may not republish it as your own.

We keep this site accurate, but it describes services rather than defining them. Pricing, volumes, delivery timescales and qualification criteria are agreed per campaign in writing, and nothing on this site is by itself an offer or a guarantee of a particular result.

Our services

Leads are supplied against criteria agreed in writing before a campaign starts. Where leads are described as exclusive, they are supplied to one client and not resold during the exclusivity period agreed. Where they are described as shared or semi-exclusive, that is stated at the point of sale.

We qualify against the criteria you give us. We cannot guarantee that a qualified prospect will buy, and no conversion rate quoted in a proposal is a contractual commitment.

Where a delivered record does not meet the agreed criteria, tell us within the return window set out in your campaign agreement and it will be replaced or credited.

Your responsibilities as a client

You are responsible for how you use the data we deliver, including compliance with the marketing, calling and data protection rules that apply in your market. If your market imposes a specific requirement on our calling — a suppression list, a consent wording, a script disclosure — tell us before the campaign starts and we will build it in.

Data protection

How we handle information collected through this site is set out in our privacy policy. Data handled on your behalf as part of a campaign is governed by your campaign agreement.

Liability

Our liability in connection with a campaign is limited to the fees paid for the work concerned. We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, including lost profit or lost business opportunity.

Changes

We may update these terms. The version published here is the current one; material changes affecting an active campaign will be raised with you directly rather than posted quietly.

Questions about any of this: contact us.

Mortgage processing covers information capture, verification of what is on the application form, and screening applications against criteria you define. Order processing covers application forms — paper and electronic — plus verification, authorisation and confirmation.

We have real domain experience in banking, credit cards, insurance and mortgage, which matters more than generic throughput: knowing which field on a form tends to be wrong is what stops an error becoming a rework cycle.

How the system is set up

Our processing design combines hardware and software knowledge with staff who understand the domain, not just the keystrokes. What that produces:

  • Efficient data capture
  • High accuracy levels
  • Delivery on schedule

Capacity scales in modules rather than all at once, and the time zone difference means work handed over at your close of business is often finished by your next morning.

uk-mortgage-leads.excerpt: Exclusive UK mortgage leads for brokers, lenders, banks and building societies — delivered within seconds of generation and never resold.
uk-mortgage-leads.body:
We generate mortgage leads for the UK market: mortgage, remortgage, secured loan, purchase and commercial mortgage leads for brokers, lenders, banks and building societies.

The upfront cost of a lead generation programme is higher than buying records off a list, and it is more than offset by conversion. Prices across the industry vary enormously, and branded mortgage lead generation is very much a case of getting what you pay for.

Exclusive, and delivered immediately

Our UK leads are exclusive and reach you within seconds of being generated. They are never retained and never resold, so you will not receive an aged record and you will not find yourself third in the queue to a prospect who has already been called twice.

We supply loan officers and financial advisers nationwide with fresh mortgage, secured loan, remortgage, purchase and commercial mortgage leads.

How we measure a programme

We measure on cost per acquisition. Generic leads typically cost 10% to 50% of a custom branded programme — but in consumer markets the cheapest lead source is rarely the one that produces the most completions.

If your current source has stopped working

Co-registration, opt-out lists and generic shared leads all share the same flaw: you cannot judge what you bought until after you have paid. If that is where your results have gone, talk to us about a branded programme built for your book.

web-marketing.title: Web Marketing Services — Email Campaigns, Response Management, Surveys and SEO
web-marketing.description: Web-enabled marketing: email campaigns, rapid-response email handling, inbox management, web surveys and search engine optimisation, joined up with your customer data.
web-marketing.keywords: web marketing services, email marketing campaigns, email response management, web surveys, search engine optimisation, web enabled services india
web-marketing.excerpt: Web-enabled marketing joined up with your customer data — email campaigns, response handling, surveys and SEO that feed each other rather than run in isolation.
web-marketing.body:
Our web-enabled marketing and database services are built to do one thing: turn what you already know about your customers into revenue and better service. Because the same team runs your customer care and technical support, the insight from those conversations feeds straight back into what you offer and to whom.

Email marketing campaigns

Email lets you stay in regular contact with customers and prospects in a way that is personalised, relevant and expected. Done consistently, it is what turns a prospect into a long-term customer. See the email marketing page for how a campaign runs.

Rapid-response email

Email is how many customers prefer to be dealt with, and a slow reply costs more than a bad one. Our email management tooling gives your customers quick, accurate, informative replies — which is what keeps an existing client base intact.

Email management

We handle incoming and outgoing email as a managed service, set up around how your business actually routes it.

Web surveys

We run surveys designed around your question, not a template. The point is not the responses; it is what they tell you about which customers to talk to next and what to say.

Search engine optimisation

Anyone can have a well-designed website. Without search optimisation, nobody finds it. We offer URL registration and optimisation packages that increase your visibility and bring more traffic to the site.

We will also call and qualify the leads that come out of it, using the same outbound survey technique we run across every campaign. Get in touch.
